skill.name: ssh
skill.description: SSH remote access patterns for connections, transfers, tunnels, key management, and troubleshooting.
skill.summary: Use SSH patterns for remote access, file transfer, tunneling, and key handling.
skill.author: Dicklesworthstone

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences in an SSH reference file. Confirmed risks remain for dynamic SOCKS proxy guidance, direct known_hosts modification, agent forwarding, and remote tunnel exposure.

remediation.issue: Agent forwarding is enabled without a warning.
remediation.suggestion: Disable ForwardAgent by default and add a warning to use it only with trusted hosts.

remediation.issue: Host keys are added from ssh-keyscan without verification.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to verify fingerprints through a trusted channel before updating known_hosts.
Add guidance for bind addresses, approvals, firewall scope, and cleanup for local and remote forwards.

remediation.issue: Private key path examples need clearer handling boundaries.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to paste, print, copy, or upload private key contents while using the skill.

content.value_statement: SSH tasks often require precise command syntax and careful handling of keys. This skill provides practical patterns for connections, transfers, tunnels, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Shows SSH connection patterns for hosts, ports, and identity files.
Documents SSH config entries, aliases, jump hosts, and bastion access.
Provides file transfer patterns using scp and rsync.
Explains local, remote, and dynamic SSH tunnels.
Covers key generation, ssh-agent use, known_hosts maintenance, and debug verbosity.
limitations: Does not verify server ownership, host fingerprints, or credential authorization.
Does not manage secrets or protect private keys automatically.
Requires local SSH tools, network access, and valid account permissions.
Includes high-risk operations that need human review before execution.

use_cases.title: Standardize server access
use_cases.description: Create repeatable SSH connection and config patterns for routine server administration.

use_cases.title: Move files between environments
use_cases.description: Plan safe file transfers with scp or rsync, including dry runs and progress options.

use_cases.title: Review remote access hygiene
use_cases.description: Check SSH key, tunnel, known_hosts, and bastion patterns before operational use.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic SSH Connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me connect to server [host] as user [user]. Ask before suggesting commands that change files.

prompt_templates.title: Create an SSH Config Entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an SSH config entry for [alias], [hostname], [user], [port], and [key path]. Include safer defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a File Transfer
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare scp and rsync for moving [path] to [destination]. Include a dry-run step when possible.

prompt_templates.title: Review Tunnel Security
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SSH tunnel plan: [details]. Identify exposure risks, host verification steps, and rollback actions.

output_examples.input: I need a config alias for staging through a bastion host.
output_examples.output: A concise SSH config outline with alias, host, user, port, ProxyJump, and safety notes.

output_examples.input: I need to sync a folder to production.
output_examples.output: A transfer plan that recommends rsync, a dry run, confirmation points, and excludes for secrets.

output_examples.input: I need to access a remote database from my laptop.
output_examples.output: A tunnel plan that limits bind scope, documents ports, and warns about exposing local services.

best_practices: Verify host fingerprints before adding or replacing known_hosts entries.
Keep private keys passphrase protected and avoid sharing key material in chats.
Use least-privilege accounts and confirm remote commands before running them.
anti_patterns: Enabling ForwardAgent by default on untrusted servers.
Adding ssh-keyscan output to known_hosts without fingerprint verification.
Running broad remote restart or sync commands without a dry run or rollback plan.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It provides SSH patterns for connections, transfers, tunnels, key handling, and troubleshooting.

faq.question: Does it run SSH commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides command patterns and requires user review before commands are executed.

faq.question: Is it safe for private keys?
faq.answer: It references key paths, but private key contents should never be shared or pasted into prompts.

faq.question: Can it help with SSH tunnels?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents local, remote, and dynamic tunnels, but tunnel exposure must be reviewed.

faq.question: Does it verify host fingerprints?
faq.answer: No. Users must verify fingerprints before adding or replacing known_hosts entries.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
